findings.label: Brand created outside row transaction
findings.message: findOrCreateBrandByName runs before the per-row $transaction, so a brand can persist even if the product write fails. Harmless orphan reused on retry; optionally move inside the transaction or clean up unused brands.

findings.label: Unrounded taxRatePct on the frontend
findings.message: The bulk page truncates stock with Math.trunc but passes taxRatePct through Number() unrounded, so a decimal GST value would fail the controller's z.number().int() and 400 the whole batch instead of becoming a per-row error. Low likelihood (GST slabs are integers); mirror the Math.trunc treatment.
